articles.summary: 1stdibs.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design products ("1stDibs" or the "Company"), today reported financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights Net revenue was $23.1 million, an increase of 5% year-over-year. Gross profit was $16.9 million, an increase of 3% year-over-year. Gross margin was 73.2%, compared to 74.3% in the third quarter 2025. GAAP net loss was $1.2 million compared to a net loss of $3.5 million in the third quarter 2025. Non-GAAP Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA Margin were $1.0 million and 4.5%, respectively, compared to $(0.2) million and (1.1)%, respectively, in the third quarter 2025. articles.summary: 1stDibs.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design products, today announced a leadership transition plan. Bradford Shellhammer, the company’s Chief Product Officer and Chief Marketing Officer, will become Chief Executive Officer and a member of the company’s Board of Directors effective January 1, 2027. David Rosenblatt, who has served as Chief Executive Officer and Chair of the Board since 2011, will transition to Executive Chair. David Rosenblatt said, “When I joined, we were a niche listings site, mostly domestic and mostly focused on vintage and antique furniture. We made the leap to become a transactional marketplace, have become fully global and established a strong presence in additional verticals. It has been an honor to lead 1stDibs for the last 15 years. articles.summary: 1stdibs.com, Inc. (Nasdaq: DIBS), a leading online marketplace for luxury design products, announced today that CEO David Rosenblatt and CFO Tom Etergino will present at the Southwest IDEAS Conference in Dallas on Wednesday, November 18 at 5:40 PM ET. A replay of the webcast will be available on the 1stDibs investor relations website for one year. About 1stDibs 1stDibs is a leading online marketplace for connecting design lovers with highly coveted sellers and makers of vintage, antique, and contemporary furniture, home décor, art, jewelry, watches, and fashion.
